thread:
tyler: fyi getting paged about a large WS reconnect surge on eu region hitting /v1/stream/subscribe around 09:15 UTC. looks correlated to increased 429 closes. anyone rolling?

ops-bot: ALERT route=/v1/stream/subscribe region=eu reconnects=2500/min error_breakdown={429:68%,1000:12%,503:10%} sample=0.5

priya: confirmed. burst starts 09:14. tenants impacted: acme-prod, sandbox-42. no infra deploy in the window.

jin: quick check of edge traces shows sdk clients reconnecting immediately after server 429 close. our old guidance was exponential backoff but js-sdk v1.6.0 seemed to remove it for non-1000 closes.

katie: console currently sums reconnects by route which hides tenant hotspots. ops asked for per-tenant timeseries + backoff latency distribution so they can see if clients obey server hints.

priya: sample proxy snippet:
```text
09:14:11 client=acme-prod close=429 reason=\"quota\"
09:14:11 client=acme-prod reconnect=1
09:14:12 client=acme-prod reconnect=2
09:14:12 client=acme-prod reconnect=3
```
jin: proposed fix: reintroduce exponential backoff in js-sdk for all non-1000 closes and accept server-sent retry hint if present. params: initial=400ms, max=20s, multiplier=2.0, jitter=0.2.

katie: telemetry changes: add event tags reconnect_reason, tenant_id, server_retry_hint_ms and record actual client-wait-ms. dashboard change: tenant table + heatmap of client-wait-ms buckets. also surface when server_hint differs from client-wait-ms median.

tyler: plan: jin -> patch sdk and canary to eu only. katie -> small console PR to add tenant timeseries and heatmap in sidecar panel. priya -> temporary quota bump for acme-prod while we validate. i'll coordinate oncall.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: js-sdk/restore-backoff -> canary:eu1 (by jin)

priya: side note: can we send a small JSON payload on close like {"retry_after_ms":1200} so clients have authoritative guidance? avoids guesswork.

jin: yes, rate-limiter can encode a short payload in close frame. sdk will prioritize that over local heuristic. adding to patch.

katie: UX: console should show server-recommendation in reconnect timeline as a pill so ops know the authoritative value. that prevents manual interventions that force lower waits.

tyler: timeline 30m for sdk canary, dashboard change in next deploy window. priya doing replay to ensure no other client versions behaving oddly. assign oncall to monitor.

ops-bot: INFO paging escalated to oncall@redwood.test due to sustained reconnect rate.

jin: canary metrics after 15m: acme-prod reconnects down ~75% and median client-wait-ms increased from ~250ms to ~1500ms (server_hint respected). looks good.

katie: opened console PR: https://git.internal/rw/console/pull/901 (tenant timeseries + reconnect-wait heatmap + server_hint column).

tyler: great. keep this thread open until both sdk and console PRs are prod and rate stabilizes. closing notes in incident doc later.
